promptSet.title: Google Antigravity Student Suite Overview & Features
promptSet.description:
Google Antigravity Student Suite – Students Get Free Google Antigravity & Gemini 4 Argon Access

Google is opening the doors to its state-of-the-art Antigravity AI agent platform with free access for students. Unlock Gemini 4 Argon, multi-agent workflows, browser automation, and terminal dev tools without paying a cent.

Designed for developers and engineering teams, Google Antigravity Student Suite accelerates implementation, eliminates repetitive development friction, and streamlines day-to-day coding workflows.

Key Features:
• Verify your student email address on the Google educational portal.
• Install the Antigravity CLI on your machine.
• Connect Gemini 4 Argon and run automated workflows directly in your terminal.
• Terminal execution log showing automated dependency audit and generated upgrade report.

Official Website: https://antigravity.google/
Instagram Breakdown: https://www.instagram.com/p/DfMrhW-ovaz/
